%1$s Force HDR Passthrough allows HDR playback when this TV doesn\'t report support. It does not force the HDMI output into HDR; Android may still convert the picture to SDR. Enable it only if you\'ve confirmed your TV supports the source format. Unsupported formats may produce a black screen or incorrect colors. True Black Bars stops Silora from drawing the bars around the picture during playback. Try it if they look grey in HDR or Dolby Vision, and turn it off again if they get lighter or show a thin line.
